mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval through different mechanisms (moxifloxacin via potassium channel blockade, prochlorperazine via dopamine antagonism), creating additive risk of cardiac arrhythmias including torsades de pointes.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only if benefits outweigh risks; monitor ECG and electrolytes; consider alternative antiemetic or antibiotic with lower QT risk.
